description: The plot illustrates the performance of different model variants on the HateXplain dataset, comparing their precision, recall, and F1-score. The x-axis is labeled "Model Variants" and has a categorical scale, with values ranging from "Full model (Ours)" to "w/o Prompt & Augmentation", representing different configurations of the model. The y-axis is labeled "Metric (%)" and has a linear scale, with values ranging from 58 to 66, representing the percentage metric values. The plot includes three lines: a purple line representing precision with a solid line style and circle markers, a blue line representing recall with a solid line style and circle markers, and a brown line representing F1-score with a solid line style and circle markers. The purple line starts at 65.49 for the full model, decreases to 61.06 without prompt, further decreases to 61.06 without augmentation, then increases to 63.7 without attention, and finally increases to 65.44 without both prompt and augmentation. The blue line starts at 65.78 for the full model, decreases to 59.64 without prompt, increases to 62.63 without augmentation, then decreases to 59.17 without both prompt and augmentation, and finally decreases to 56.82. The brown line starts at 65.49 for the full model, decreases to 60.16 without prompt, increases to 62.22 without augmentation, then decreases to 59.67 without both prompt and augmentation, and finally decreases to 57.74.
